svg.title: Company data areas and shared records
svg.desc: Nine data areas organize all 82 tables. Sales, Design Services, purchasing, manufacturing, payroll, accounting, fixed assets, planning, and shared master records have focused linked views. The layout groups evidence rather than imposing a company-wide sequence.
